payload.title: [Fig. 2] Naïve sampling
payload.summary: This notebook focuses on analyzing climate model data using naïve sampling techniques. It calculates the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between a target series and ensemble trajectories, and performs spectral analysis to understand the data's frequency components. The notebook uses various Python libraries to process and visualize climate data, ultimately producing figures that illustrate the closest match and spectral characteristics of the data.
goals: Compute Mean Squared Error between target series and ensemble trajectories
Perform spectral analysis on climate data
